beats.text: This black hole has been humming one note for longer than humans have existed.
Raised high enough for us to hear, it sounds like this.
It's a B flat, fifty seven octaves below middle C.
One wave takes ten million years. Our species is only about three hundred thousand years old.
beats.header: One wave ≈ 33× all of human history
Detected by NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory
